high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "radioactron." The post features a close-up view of the Earth from space, with a focus on its curvature and cloud formations. The background shows the vastness of space, emphasizing the Earth's small size in comparison to the cosmos. The post includes the following text: Likes: 1,935 likes. Content: The post describes the Sun as a "gigantic ball" that holds 99.8% of the solar system's mass and is roughly 109 times the diameter of the Earth.
